name: ORANGE PEEL
source:
Orange Peel, a girl who was disappointed by a bastard father and ran away from home.
Aim for the house of a magician who is said to "cherish his family."

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26597]Freem![/url]]
translation:

目标是据说“珍惜家人”的魔术师的房子。
